fields.description: Master kill-switch. When unchecked the validate hook no-ops and ERPNext's standard tax template applies.
fields.label: Enable OpenSalesTax

fields.description: URL of the OpenSalesTax engine, e.g. https://tax.example.com
fields.label: Engine Base URL

fields.description: Optional Bearer token if your engine requires authentication. Leave blank for anonymous access.
fields.label: API Key (Optional)

fields.description: Uncheck only for self-signed development instances. Always ON in production.
fields.label: Verify SSL Certificate

fields.description: How long to cache tax rate lookups per ZIP. 86400 seconds = 24 hours.
fields.label: Cache TTL (seconds)

fields.description: When the engine is unreachable, silently fall back to the user's tax template (recommended). Uncheck to block invoice save on engine errors.
fields.label: Fail Soft on Engine Error

fields.description: GL account that tax lines post to. Typically a liability account such as 'Sales Tax Payable'.
fields.label: Tax Account Head

fields.description: Optional. If set, shipping-related tax is tracked separately.
fields.label: Shipping Income Account

fields.description: Comma-separated list of US 2-letter state codes (e.g. "MN,WI,IA") the merchant has nexus in. When set, the engine is only called for invoices whose ship-to state is in this list — for any other state, ERPNext's default tax behavior takes over (typically: no tax). Leave blank to call the engine for every US/USD invoice (pre-v0.2 behavior). Missing or unresolvable destination state with the filter active is fail-closed.
fields.label: Nexus States (comma-separated)

fields.description: When an item has an Item Tax Template set, skip the OpenSalesTax computation for that item (the merchant has marked it as having override rates).
fields.label: Respect Item Tax Templates as Overrides

fields.description: Allow connecting to an OpenSalesTax engine on a private/RFC-1918 IP (e.g. 10.x, 192.168.x). Required only for LAN deployments. Default OFF for SSRF defense.
fields.label: Allow Private Networks
Calculation-Only Disclaimer
fields.options: Calculation only. Tax calculations are provided as-is for convenience. The merchant is solely responsible for tax-collection accuracy and remittance to the appropriate jurisdictions. Verify against your state Department of Revenue before remitting.
